title: Questions 176-180 refer to the following memo and job advertisement.
passage_1:
MEMORANDUM

To: Section Leaders
From: Ines Barros
Date: June 20
Subject: Change of plan

As you know, the weather service says that a long spell of heavy rain is likely to set in by the middle of July. This gives us a considerably narrower window to cut the lavender in the west fields.

Our current estimates indicate that we will not be able to finish the harvest on schedule with our present workforce alone, even if shifts are extended. Therefore, we must expand our workforce by at least 35 percent.

I have approved an urgent recruitment push to bring in 12 extra workers immediately. The advertisement has just been published. Please make sure we have enough tools for them by this Wednesday. Also, be aware that the training of the new recruits will be held on their first day.

URGENT HIRING: Seasonal Farm Work

(Posted: June 20)

Ridgemoor Lavender Farm needs extra workers immediately. We are looking for reliable individuals to help us cut our crop of lavender before the wet weather arrives.

Position: Seasonal Field Worker
Contract Duration: July 1 – July 28
Pay Rate: $17.50/hr + Finishing Bonus ($150)

Key Duties:

  • Cutting stems
  • Sorting produce for florists
  • Helping with trailer loading

Requirements:

  • Able to begin immediately
  • The physical strength to lift crates weighing up to 20 kg and to work while bending
  • A willingness to work in all weather conditions

*No qualifications needed (training given on site)

To Apply:

Please e-mail your name and contact details to work@ridgemoorlavender.com with the subject line “Seasonal Work.”
